purpose: Bounded per-joint action-impulse authority bank on the frozen yawref-cigate8m checkpoint and frozen full-mesh plant: measure whether small single-joint normalized-action pulses causally change real integrated yaw while retaining forward progress, loaded-foot slip and safety, after actual servo/contact dynamics.

frozen_assets.no_regeneration: The stale 3.49 kg XML must not be regenerated or substituted; abort if identity check fails.

design.command_shape: 1 s zero hold + 1 s linear ramp to (vx, wz), then constant (identical to turnauth_corrected_20260907 protocol)
design.settled_states_per_cell: P1 = first tick index >= 600 (t=6.0 s) whose goal_mode is walk; P2 = tick in [P1+25, P1+50] whose post-prefix walk-phase is circularly closest to phase(P1)+pi (half gait cycle at goal.walk_phase_hz=1.333333 is 37.5 ticks).
design.variants_per_state: 1 zero-delta control + 18 joints x {+0.05, -0.05} normalized-action pulses = 37
design.pulse: delta added to the deterministic policy action on exactly one action dim for 5 consecutive ticks starting at the branch tick, clipped to the action space; then the unchanged policy runs for 0.75 s (75 ticks). Scoring window = 80 ticks from pulse start.
design.reconstruction: Every branch is reconstructed by an identical fresh env construction (same seed/cfg), identical reset, identical phase offset, and deterministic prefix replay of the full controller (GRU/hidden-state reset + replay preserves complete controller history). No state teleporting, no population reweighting, no nominal FK.
design.exactness_gate: The zero-delta branch of every state must match the continuous baseline bit-exactly: final qpos array equality at tick P+80 and identical window trace hash. Any mismatch invalidates the entire bank (infrastructure failure); no rankings may be reported as evidence.

measures: d_yaw_rad: real integrated signed body yaw (unwrapped chassis xmat yaw) over the 80-tick window
fwd_disp_m: chassis XY displacement over the window projected on the body heading at pulse start
loaded_slip_m: sum over window ticks and feet in contact (touch > 0.5 N) of per-tick pad XY displacement
safety: termination flag/reason, max |roll_rel_deg|, max |pitch_rel_deg|, non-walk goal-mode ticks in window
clip_frac: fraction of pulse ticks where the pulsed dim was clipped by the action-space bound

preregistered_criteria.effect_threshold: baseline-relative commanded-direction yaw gain sign(wz)*(d_yaw_branch - d_yaw_baseline) >= 0.005 rad over the 80-tick window

retention.health: no termination in window; max|roll| and max|pitch| <= baseline max + 3.0 deg; all window ticks in walk mode

preregistered_criteria.repeatability: States are matched ACROSS starts by circular walk-phase distance < 0.6 rad. A (joint, pulse-sign) pair qualifies for a wz sign if it meets effect+retention in BOTH members of at least one matched-phase pair (start 0 vs start pi).
preregistered_criteria.both_signs_qualification: A steering direction qualifies only if a qualifying (joint, sign) pair exists for wz=+0.15 toward +yaw AND for wz=-0.15 toward -yaw (mirrored joints allowed; mirror structure is reported, not required).
preregistered_criteria.primary_ranking: branches ranked by baseline-relative commanded-direction yaw gain, reported with full retention metrics per (cell, state); retention screens are pass/fail, not re-rankable after data.

explicit_non_claims: A single 5-tick open-loop impulse response does NOT establish or predict sustained closed-loop steering control; no such claim will be made from this bank.

A qualifying result authorizes ONLY the next validation: an explicit bounded state-dependent residual evaluated on the original 15 s both-signs/straight panel (turnauth_corrected_20260907 protocol cells (0.08,0), (0.08,+0.15), (0.08,-0.15), starts 0/pi, seed 0). Only if THAT panel supports it is one 2M assisted canary placed via launch_run.py.
A non-qualifying bank records unsupported scope for THIS pulse class only; it does not close broader gait or action classes.
No generic time-slicing, pricing, cadence, torsion or BC-dose retry is licensed by any outcome.
Physical limits and the continuous-joystick qualification criteria are unchanged; no physical robot involvement.
